name: Oskarström - Gyltige
description: Oskarström to Gyltige. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Official Hallandsleden page/API/GPX and Naturkartan title/shape define current Oskarström - Gyltige. OSM relation 7398310, Wikiloc, old field reports, Destination Halmstad naming and Naturkartan slug preserve old Ryet-Gyltige/Gyltige-Ryet framing.

Hallandsleden map API geo_json exactly matches official GPX full 411-point route, while nested line.geometry is a 983-point/15.486 km partial line starting 3.386 km east of Oskarström and ending 468.8 m short of Gyltige.
Official page/API display 22 km/22000 m, while GPX desc says Total: 21.6 km and computed 2D length is 21.525 km.
Dricksvatten Oskarström says the public toilet/water point is temporarily closed due vandalism, while Toalett Oskarström says a public toilet with water exists by the bus stop.

Destination Halmstad and OSM support Gyltige drinking water and dry toilet, while Hallandsleden does not expose water/toilet category records for Gyltige on S2 and adjacent official section pages say no toilet at Gyltige.

Södra overview page says six sections/from Gyltige to Koarp, while official API returns nine Södra track segments including Frodeparken - Oskarström, Oskarström - Gyltige and Kvarnforsen - Gyltige. S2 and S3 both terminate at Gyltige in stored geometry directions.

facilities.name: Virsehatt nature reserve parking
facilities.description: Mid-stage reserve access by the trail/reserve, not start/end access; accessible dry toilet nearby.

facilities.name: Gyltige parking
facilities.description: Closest car/pickup access at Gyltige. Public-transit access is weak.

facilities.name: Lägerplats Gyltige / Gyltige vindskydd
facilities.description: Endpoint campsite at Gyltige. Official text says two shelters facing each other with a fireplace between; Naturkartan says each shelter holds 4-5 adults, with a small detour from the trail and a view over Gyltigesjön.

facilities.name: Gyltige parking / Simlångsgården parking
facilities.description: Public surface parking near the Gyltige endpoint/campsite. OSM tags access yes, fee no and capacity 30.

facilities.name: Oskarströms tågstation
facilities.description: Rail station near the Oskarström start; transit lane identifies Krösatågen/JLT/Hallandstrafiken regional rail access.

facilities.name: ICA Nära Oskarström
facilities.description: Official grocery/resupply POI at the Oskarström start area. OSM opening hours observed by facilities lane: 08:00-21:00.

facilities.name: Bykokerskan
facilities.description: Restaurant at Oskarström start area. Official description says Swedish home cooking and Asian menu.

facilities.name: Virsehatts naturreservat
facilities.description: Nature reserve and Natura 2000 area on the route. Hallandsleden recommends a detour to the summit/view. County page lists fireplace, information board, public transport, parking, picnic/rest area, accessibility, dry toilet and hiking trail.

facilities.name: Toalett Virsehatt naturreservat
facilities.description: Accessible dry toilet by the Virsehatt parking area.

facilities.name: Virsehatt parking
facilities.description: Reserve parking directly by the trail/reserve access.

facilities.name: Virsehatt viewpoint
facilities.description: Summit/viewpoint detour in Virsehatt reserve. Official section description recommends climbing to the top for views.

facilities.name: Rödek utmed leden
facilities.description: Lone northern red oak beside the trail; official things-worth-seeing item.

facilities.name: Hålväg
facilities.description: Old sunken road/track formed by historic traffic and erosion.
